title: Reliability state observability bounds
summary: Expose bounded runtime reliability health and retention controls for pending done reports, ActiveJobs ambiguity, coordinator ledgers, log size, SQLite completed rows, and autonomy scan truncation.
reason: Thirty-day unattended operation needs visible lower-bound metrics and bounded mirrors so failure evidence can accumulate without unbounded memory/state growth or unsafe automatic recovery decisions.
behavior_before: Runtime/autonomy health did not expose several long-run failure counters, ActiveJobs ambiguity was not a hard read-first blocker, scan truncation was not surfaced as lower-bound evidence, and SQLite completed_jobs rows were not trimmed by maintenance policy.
behavior_after: Runtime/autonomy health reports pending done age, heartbeat failure age, ActiveJobs read-first ambiguity, coordinator quarantine/ledger metrics, debug log and SQLite limits, scan truncation lower bounds, and SQLite maintenance trims completed_jobs above the configured cap while JSONL remains authoritative.
manual_validation: Targeted Python health/storage/config suites passed; generate_config_schema --check and refresh_summaries --changed passed; validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage passed. ai_guardrail postflight exited 1 after reporting broad risky-file validation requirements from the large dirty worktree; real-media/30-day soak not run.
rollback_plan: Revert the runtime health, autonomy health, config, schema, SQLite maintenance, documentation, and targeted test changes; JSONL completed manifests remain authoritative if the SQLite trim behavior is removed.
